title: arctium tomentosum subsp. palladinii
intro: Arctium tomentosum subsp. palladinii, commonly known as Woolly Burdock, is a subspecies of the Burdock plant, characterized by its distinctive woolly leaves and stems. The health benefits of Woolly Burdock include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Woolly Burdock include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Woolly Burdock include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and polyphenols, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
